Fix: EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(16,8,72,12) on map-details SingleChildScrollView, inside the existing body SafeArea (quizipedia.dart:868). Global FAB (feedback.dart:162-173) is FloatingActionButton.small (40x40 tight, confirmed in local Flutter 3.47.1 SDK source) at PositionedDirectional(end:12) with its own SafeArea; reach from the safe trailing edge is ~52-56px incl. default tap-target padding. 72px reservation clears it with ~16-20px margin. Uses directional (end) padding matching the FAB's own directional placement, so it holds under RTL too. Screenshots (mobile.png/desktop.png) visually confirm no overlap at 361x738; errors.json empty.

Blocking finding: red-repro.log does not match the shipped test. It fails a test named 'map footer stays clear of feedback on a narrow screen' with the failing expect at feedback_test.dart:50 - but the committed test only contains the parameterized 'map footer stays clear of feedback at ${scale}x text' tests (1.0x/2.0x, FakeViewPadding 24px insets); line 50 there is `matching: find.text(name)`, not an expect. So RED evidence is stale, from an earlier, simpler, non-parameterized, non-safe-inset version of the regression - not the final shipped one, whose GREEN run (green-scaled.log) does match test names exactly. There is no verified proof the actual shipped, scale/safe-inset-aware test fails pre-fix - only that an earlier, less rigorous variant did. REPORT_EN.md states 'It failed before the fix (overlap true)' without disclosing this, overstating verified evidence.

Smallest fix: revert only the padding line, rerun `flutter test test/feedback_test.dart` to capture RED against the exact final test content, reapply the fix, regenerate GREEN, update review-inputs.json hashes; or explicitly disclose in REPORT_EN.md that red-repro predates the parameterized/safe-inset test and no RED exists for the final version.

Other checks: analyze.log clean (0 issues/2 files). GREEN run matches committed test names, 18/18 pass incl. quizipedia_test.dart. No production/Android/deployment claims made or needing verification.

## Review summary — task-530e00d17fb643c7853f65222fde7570

**Verdict: REWORK** (requirements-compliance), code-quality: accept.

**What checks out:**
- All 67 files in `review-inputs.json` verified by sha256; the commit touches only `quizipedia.dart` (one padding line + comment), `feedback_test.dart`, `.beads/issues.jsonl` (→ `in_progress`), and the evidence folder — no data/catalog/API/dependency changes.
- The fix (`EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(16,8,72,12)`, inside the existing body `SafeArea`) geometrically clears the feedback FAB: it's a `FloatingActionButton.small` (40×40, confirmed in the local Flutter 3.47.1 SDK source) at `end:12`, reaching ~52–56px from the safe trailing edge, leaving a 16–20px margin under the 72px reservation. It correctly uses directional padding, matching the FAB's own directional placement (holds under RTL).
- Screenshots and `analyze.log`/GREEN logs all confirm the fix works and matches the final test as shipped.

**Blocking finding:** `red-repro.log` doesn't match the shipped test — it fails a test literally named `map footer stays clear of feedback on a narrow screen` at line 50, but the committed test only has the parameterized `at ${scale}x text` variants (with `FakeViewPadding` safe insets), where line 50 is not even an assertion. So there's no verified RED run for the actual, final regression test — only for an earlier, simpler iteration — while `REPORT_EN.md` claims "It failed before the fix" without disclosing this. Smallest fix: re-capture RED against the exact final test (or disclose the gap explicitly).

Full findings and evidence trail are in the hub task review note.
